title: AlphaApollo: A System for Deep Agentic Reasoning

mechanism.populationDetail: The paper explicitly describes test-time evolution as a free-form multi-round pipeline, not a maintained candidate population.
mechanism.archiveDetail: No elite archive or persistent candidate population is defined; per-round solution/judgment pairs are retained in long-term memory.
mechanism.generationDetail: Later-round solutions are conditioned on memory of earlier solution/judgment pairs, but the paper does not specify direct editing/inheritance or a fixed parent relation.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Agentic tool-use trajectories and a four-role solver/abstractor/evaluator/summarizer pipeline are coupled to test-time solution improvement.

provenance.sourcePdf: additional_papers/202603/AlphaApollo A System for Deep Agentic Reasoning.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: The paper specifies a dual-model policy/verifier configuration in the evolution experiment, but not a fixed count of parallel solver workers or any population/parent topology.
